senses.gloss: f. (= תרתרנית, reduplic. of תּוּר) [one in the habit of espying, sniffing like a dog,] one whose sense of smell is defective.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 146a:13">B. Bath. 146ᵃ</cite> they told a man <he>אשתו ת׳ היא וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>תתר׳</he>; Ms. H. <he>תתרנאית</he>) that his (intended) wife was a ‘sniffer’; he went after her … to test her &c.
